development.name: Capitol Park and Lagoon
development.description: A public landscape surrounding the provincial capitol lagoon, offering leafy paths and opportunities to appreciate the civic setting. The travel guide reports daily 05:00-22:00 and free ordinary entry; temporary closures and event restrictions may differ.
development.address: Provincial Capitol Complex, Bacolod City, Negros Occidental

development.name: Negros Forest Park
development.description: A conservation and wildlife education center presenting native Negros species and the work of the Talarak Foundation. Reported Tuesday-Sunday hours are 09:00-17:00; Monday is unspecified. Historical 2022 admission reports give PHP 100 for adults and PHP 50 for eligible discounted visitors; current prices are not operator-confirmed.
development.address: South Capitol Road, Bacolod City, Negros Occidental 6100

development.name: Negros Occidental Provincial Capitol
development.description: The provincial government’s prominent capitol building, an architectural focal point of central Bacolod. Reported schedule: Tuesday-Friday 08:00-19:00, citing the provincial government website; these may be office hours rather than confirmed tourist access hours. Entrance is reported as free; visitor access and admission are not independently verified.
development.address: Provincial Capitol Building, Gatuslao Street, Bacolod City, Negros Occidental 6100

development.name: Orange Project
development.description: A contemporary art gallery within Mandalagan’s Art District, featuring exhibitions and work by local and visiting artists. Reported exhibition admission varies: PHP 0-50 is an indicative range, not a guaranteed future tariff. The cited PHP 50 article concerns March-June 2026 exhibitions; confirm the current exhibition before visiting.
development.address: Orange Project Building, Art District, Lopue’s Annex Building, Mandalagan, Bacolod City, Negros Occidental 6100

development.name: Panaad Park and Sports Complex
development.description: A provincial park and sports venue in Mansilingan used for major local events and the Panaad sa Negros Festival. Hours and fees await confirmation.
development.address: Barangay Mansilingan, Bacolod City, Negros Occidental
